messages:
maria: quick heads-up — I'm about to open a staged rollout for reranker_v4 (flag: rerank_v4_enabled). plan: 1% -> 5% -> 20% over 4h windows. want to confirm guardrails and stopping rules before I kick off. pinging @kenji for infra constraints and @samir for experiment config.

kenji: infra: GPUs and serving pools are clear for those qps at the proposed slices. we'll cap per-instance concurrency to avoid OOM. please include desired max_batch and model quantization in the rollout config.

samir: from an experiments POV, primary metric = CTR@10 (clicks within top10). secondary = p50 latency. proposed stop rules: pause if CTR drops >2.5 percentage points absolute vs baseline for two consecutive 30m windows OR p50 latency increases by >100ms for two consecutive windows. also want stratified checks by region and new-vs-returning users.

olivia: agreed on metrics. baseline numbers: CTR@10 baseline = 12.8%, p50 latency baseline = 210ms. add a hard kill if CTR drops >5pp in any single window. also need QA confirmation that the evaluator tests passed on heldout prompts.

maria: noted. rollout windows = 4h each, will wait 30m after each window for guardrail checks before expanding. starting cohort = 1% stratified by region (proportional) and by activity bucket (>=3 sessions in 30d). will register experiment_id = rerank_v4_staged_2026_03 and include eval hash.

samir: adding the SQL we use for CTR@10 calc (for monitors):

```sql
SELECT cohort, SUM(clicked)/SUM(impression) AS ctr10, COUNT(*) as impressions
FROM events
WHERE rank <= 10 AND experiment_id = 'rerank_v4_staged_2026_03'
GROUP BY cohort;
```

samir: I'll add stratified anomaly detectors and a rolling baseline comparison job. can we also auto-pause if impressions <1000 in a window (so noisy stats don't trigger false positives)?

kenji: makes sense. ops: set max_batch = 16, kv_cache = enabled, quantization = int8-fast path. adding fallback route to reranker_v3 when capacity is saturated. also will throttle background prefetches during first 2 windows.

maria: here's the rollout config I'll push to the flag system: 

```json
{
  "flag": "rerank_v4_enabled",
  "stages": [
    {"pct": 1, "duration": "4h"},
    {"pct": 5, "duration": "4h"},
    {"pct": 20, "duration": "4h"}
  ],
  "audience": ["by_region:proportional", "activity:>=3_sessions_30d"],
  "stop_rules": ["ctr_drop_abs>2.5pp_2windows", "p50_latency_increase>100ms_2windows", "ctr_drop_abs>5pp_any_window"],
  "fallback": "reranker_v3"
}
```

maria: also tagging the eval run id: eval_2026_03_15_rerank_v4_sha:abc123 so we can tie quality regressions back to evals.

deploy-bot: scheduled rollout job rerank_v4_staged_2026_03 at 2026-03-15T14:30Z. monitors will be attached: experiments-ctr10, infra-latency, region-stratified-alerts.

olivia: who will be on-call for the first 2h of the rollout? need someone to triage if a monitor trips.

maria: I can own the first window. @kenji can you be backup for infra?

kenji: yup I'll be on-call for infra during windows 1-2. set pager to kenji + maria.

samir: I'll keep an eye on the experiment dashboards and jump in if stratified CTRs diverge. adding monitor: auto-pause when impressions>=1000 and ctr_change<-2.5pp.

olivia: QA quick check — can you paste the evaluator pass list? I want sign-off before stage 2.

maria: QA passed list: synthetic_prompts_v2, real_anon_sample_3k, regression_suite_small. all green. pushing now.

kenji: one final note — we should run a short smoke at 0.1% to sanity-check traffic routing before 1% if you want. takes ~10m.

maria: good call. starting 0.1% smoke for 10m then moving to 1% after checks. will update experiment record and ping this thread. :thumbsup:

samir: acked. thanks all.

olivia: :raised_hands:
